title: array2table
summary: Convert an array into a table.

gpu_support.notes: Inputs are gathered before table materialization.

description: `array2table(A)` splits a homogeneous two-dimensional array into table variables by column. Native integer columns preserve the exact class and values of `A`.
behaviors: Numeric, complex, logical, string, and cell arrays are split column-wise.
`"VariableNames"`, `"RowNames"`, and `"DimensionNames"` are supported. Current variable names may contain Unicode, spaces, and leading or trailing whitespace; row-name edge whitespace is removed.
Interactive resident GPU input is a mode-gated RunMat extension. It gathers exact typed storage before table construction and rejects in MATLAB-compatible mode.
